'''The Great Seal''' is a [[special]] card.  It first appeared in the [[Kingsport Horror]] expansion.

==Card info==
'''Any Phase''': When you seal a [[gate]], you may place this card on the sealed [[location]] along with the [[Elder Sign token]].  That elder sign token cannot be removed by any game effect, including [[gate burst]]s.
